cases.title: s8 t1: a v7 store opens at version 8 with the subsystem tables and its rows unchanged; a fresh store has them
s8 t1: a write replaces the set in one transaction, stamped with the generation; a subsystem whose id was stored keeps its summary

cases.title: s8 t2: every file is in exactly one group
s8 t2: the same graph gives the same groups, also with its edges and files shuffled
s8 t2: two dense clusters joined by one weak edge are two groups; a file with no relationships joins its directory through the same-directory edge
s8 t2: ids are the hash of the sorted members, names the longest common directory, and connections sum the edges between groups
s8 t2: a file tied between two groups joins the smaller one, whatever the edge order
s8 t2: groups aggregate: modules strongly linked in pairs end as one group per pair
s8 t2: connections count only relationships, never the same-directory edges, even between groups of one directory

tests.name: subsystem summaries through the cheap-tier provider

cases.title: s8 t4: summaries are written only for new memberships; an unchanged subsystem keeps its summary and causes no call
s8 t4: the summary calls are made one at a time
s8 t4: a failing call leaves that summary empty and the others written
s8 t4: a generation that advances while summaries are written stops further writes
s8 t4: a summary is stored only on the subsystem rows of the generation it was written for
